title: Update recurring donation card
description: Authorize this card for future payments of this subscription. Verify it with your bank without a charge now; the amount and schedule stay the same.
success: Card verified and linked to future payments. No money was charged now.
error: The card update could not be confirmed. Check your subscription or contact the institution before trying again.
cardsDescription: The default card applies to new donations only. To replace a card on an existing plan, open recurring donations and complete bank verification.
cardInUse: This card is linked to a plan or pending verification and cannot be removed. Replace the plan card first.
removeWarning: This removes the saved card. Cards linked to a plan cannot be removed.
